product.enabledHelp: Enables the booking/ticketing flow for this product.
product.resourceHelp: The resource this ticket belongs to (venue, room, network, …). Scanner and statistics group by resource.
product.validityModeHelp: Slot: bound to a booked calendar date. Period: valid for a duration. Unlimited: never expires.
product.presetHelp: Pre-fills the ISO-8601 duration — pick "Custom" for any other value (e.g. PT4H, P2W, P18M).
product.durationHelp: Examples: P1D = 1 day, P1M = 1 month, P1Y = 1 year, PT4H = 4 hours.
product.validityAnchorHelp: Purchase: from the moment of purchase. First use: activated by the first scan (transit style). Customer: the customer picks the start date in the shop.
product.entryPolicyHelp: Single: the ticket is consumed by the first scan. Multi: re-usable for the whole validity window (pass).

notification.invalidDuration: Period tickets need a valid ISO-8601 duration (e.g. P1D, P1M, P1Y).

product.rotatingQrEnabledHelp: The ticket QR rotates over time (TOTP). A screenshot expires within seconds — protects against ticket sharing. Holders show the live code in their account/app; the scanner verifies it online.
product.rotatingQrIntervalHelp: How often the code changes. Default 30s (10–120).
